lib.emptyConfirm: Permanently delete ALL files in trash?
settings.taggerHint: Optional feature: pip install -r requirements-ml.txt (onnxruntime-gpu). Work is distributed across the GPUs enabled above.
settings.qualityHint: Scores 0-100 with issues, using blur/exposure/contrast/resolution heuristics plus generation-settings checks (low steps, extreme CFG). ML anatomy detection is on the roadmap.
settings.orgHint: Moves files matching the current Library filters (search/tool/group/quality) into template paths. Variables: {model} {tool} {date} {group} {sampler}
settings.orgConfirm: Move files as shown in the preview?
settings.authHint: When enabled, all API access requires login (unnecessary for personal localhost use). Passwords are stored as scrypt hashes.
settings.usersHint: Regular users can only browse/rate the library, analyze single images and view stats. Settings, scans and file operations (anything touching paths/system) are admin-only.
auth.weak: Username and a password of 4+ chars required
scan.title: New scan
scan.hint: Type any local path to scan it directly. Directories registered in Settings are offered as autocomplete suggestions. For very large directories, adjust the worker count to control system load.
settings.cleanupHint: Removes library entries for files deleted or moved outside the app.
settings.dirsHint: Bookmarks for frequently used paths — suggested as autocomplete/default in the Scan tab, and files under these paths may be displayed even before they are in the library. Unregistered paths can still be scanned.
scan.dirInput: Type a directory path or pick a registered one
analyze.title: Analyze a single image
analyze.drop: Drop an image here or click to upload
settings.gpuHint: Selected GPUs will be used for upcoming ML image analysis (category / outfit / background / quality detection).
audit.title: Audit log
audit.hint: Durable record of actions that changed state (scans, deletions, settings, accounts). Progress logs go to data/gensight-app.log instead.
toast.copyBlocked: the browser blocked clipboard access (needs window focus and localhost/HTTPS)
settings.dirsCatalogNote: Unregistering a directory leaves its already-scanned records in the library — use "Clean records" on the entry to remove those too.
settings.dirRemoveConfirmRows: Unregistering. The {n} library record(s) under this path will remain — continue?
settings.dirRemovedRecordsKept: Unregistered — records remain. Use 'Clean records' to remove them
settings.purgeRootPlaceholder: Path to clean (paths only left in the library work too)
settings.purgeModeMissing: Only records whose file is gone
settings.purgeHint: Removes library records only — files are never deleted. Records move to the archive and can be restored, and re-scanning the same path revives tags/quality without recomputing them.
settings.purgeConfirm: Clean the library records as shown in the preview? (files are not deleted and records can be restored from the archive)
settings.purgeAtRisk: Work that would go with them
settings.purgeActiveScan: A scan is running on this path
settings.purgePaddedRoot: The path has leading/trailing whitespace — confirm this is the path you meant
settings.archivePruneAllConfirm: Permanently delete the entire archive? This cannot be undone.
settings.archiveHint: Entries past the retention window are pruned automatically (0 = prune by hand only). Deleting all is irreversible.
settings.archiveSkipped: skipped, a newer record already exists
